prices.law: THE PRICE OF THE PLUG (Codex law, owner-confirmed Oct 25): (1) an outside app/AI plugs in for its own subscription price, carried in the bundle — no second, invented plug fee, ever; (2) our cut is the toll on the flow across the plug, never a charge on the door (door + flow both charged = double-gating = empty room); (3) his own fleet plugs in for zero — house into house; (4) a maker with no subscription pays in people — plugging in ties his users to the table. CHARGE FOR ALL OF IT (owner, Oct 25): every layer is chargeable — the tool, the window (the guided opening), the door (keeping it propped — the watch), the plumbing (the toll on the flow). PLUGGING INTO THE TABLE COSTS (owner law, Oct 26 10:34 — 'OneMind plug ins the tools plug into the table and adding them cost duh'): adding a tool to the table is itself a chargeable event — never free, never implied. Every plug in this book carries its charge as an explicit written entry (each plug's plug_in_charge), priced by the Price of the Plug above: an outside tool plugs in for its own subscription price carried in the bundle (no invented plug fee), our cut is the toll on the flow across the plug, the owner's own fleet plugs in for zero (house into house), and a maker with no subscription pays in people.
